title: Add Ninja Forms as a form provider (create-contact-form, plugin catalog, triggers, skill)
body:
## What
Add Ninja Forms as a first-class form provider in SD AI Agent, so the agent can create and manage forms on sites that use Ninja Forms (the CEF chapter template and every site cloned from it now use Ninja Forms only; WPForms is being retired there).

## Why
`sd-ai-agent/create-contact-form` only knows WPForms Lite, Contact Form 7 and an HTML fallback. On a Ninja Forms site it silently returns the dependency-free HTML block, so the CEF Setup Assistant cannot embed a real, notification-backed form.

## Files to modify
- `includes/Abilities/ContentAbilities.php`: add a Ninja Forms provider to `create_contact_form_result()` (Ninja Forms first, then WPForms when it is the active form plugin, then Contact Form 7, then the HTML block); add a `sd_ai_agent_contact_form_providers` filter so tests and sites can reorder or disable providers; update the ability description.
- `includes/Core/AbilityPluginRegistry.php`: add a `ninja-forms` catalog entry; reword the WPForms and Contact Form 7 entries (WPForms is supported when already active, not recommended for new sites).
- `includes/Automations/EventTriggerRegistry.php`: add a "Ninja Form Submitted" trigger on `ninja_forms_after_submission` (args `form_data`).
- `includes/Models/skills/contact-forms.md`: make Ninja Forms the recommended provider; document the `[ninja_form id="N"]` shortcode and detection.
- `tests/SdAiAgent/Abilities/ContentAbilitiesTest.php`, `tests/SdAiAgent/Automations/EventTriggerRegistryTest.php`, `.wp-env.json` (install Ninja Forms in the test environment).

## Reference pattern
The existing `create_wpforms_form()` / `build_wpforms_form_data()` in `ContentAbilities.php` and the Gravity Forms / WPForms triggers in `EventTriggerRegistry.php`.

## Behaviour
- Provider id `ninja-forms`, shortcode `[ninja_form id="N"]`, shortcode block returned like the WPForms path.
- Form: Name, Email, Subject, Message, submit button; Ninja Forms' built-in honeypot stays on. Actions: save submission, email notification to the recipient (reply-to the submitter's email), success message.
- No `affected` post descriptor (Ninja Forms forms are not posts).

## Verification
- `pnpm run wp-env:start` then `pnpm run test:php` for the three test classes: provider selection, created form fields/actions/recipient, fallback to HTML when no provider is active, and the new trigger registration.
- `composer lint` (PHPCS and PHPStan) clean on the changed files.
